name: tovar
description: tovar: Claude Code themes, output styles, CLAUDE.md snippets, character bars, shell tools and architect mode.

plugins.name: tovar-core
plugins.description: Personalize Claude Code with themes, output styles and global CLAUDE.md snippets, all managed through skills. Ships examples, your own items live in the plugin data folder.

plugins.name: tovar-mods
plugins.description: Character bars above the prompt: a character for what Claude is doing, then a narration of each turn in their own voice and color.

plugins.name: tovar-shell
plugins.description: Shell tools styled by your tovar theme: a tmux config and a game-style menu whose colors and look follow the active theme.

plugins.name: architect-mode
plugins.description: Experts judge, you decide, and code changes only after your approval.
